analysis.visual_description: On the board. A leaf of the comedy on the table by the cheese. Her pen lies in the margin. Two words are struck in his hand and rewritten above in a smaller hand.
On the board. The same leaf, a corner turned where a thumb held it. Nothing else on the page is touched.
On the board. The leaf stays when the hand leaves. The pen stays. A rind of cheese is at the edge.
